name: IHSAA Cross Country Regionals
where: Indiana · New Prairie, Manchester, Brownsburg, Columbus (CERAland Sports Park) and Crawford County
headline: IHSAA Cross Country Regionals
summary: Indiana's regional round decides who runs at the IHSAA state finals on Oct. 31 at the LaVern Gibson course in Terre Haute. At Crawford County, DyeStat's No. 10 Calvin Seitz (Springs Valley) and No. 16 Carter Zieren (Evansville Reitz) meet head to head. No. 21 Fort Wayne Carroll boys and No. 14 Homestead girls race at Manchester, No. 22 Carmel girls at Brownsburg, and Hamilton Southeastern's Anya Zoeller (No. 25) at CERAland.
